decisions.reason: Lever handle families in architectural hardware have long lifecycles, and two years on the market is too short to justify withdrawal given tooling and specification investments.
The mitred family supports the coordinated design range that architects specify, and its sunk tooling costs favor keeping it.
A multifunctional lever fits the firm's expanding barrier-free and system-solution strategy, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The award-winning FSB 1289 collection is a flagship with its own presence and design recognition, making it a core keeper.
The bronze finish uses in-house finishing capability across many models at low maintenance cost and supports premium positioning.
